steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What's with this woman...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: ...You there.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: The Reunion forces worked like a well-oiled machine when they took over the Chernobog military strongholds.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: But your men act like deranged thugs.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Mindless slaughter, burning down the city, hunting down innocents... This was all for your own sadistic pleasure, was it not?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Someone base enough to plot these senseless crimes at a time like this... could not possibly have designed the plan to take down an entire city.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Your commander probably ordered you to cause chaos, but you succumbed to your perversion and tastelessness.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...Faust.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I want her shot through the mouth.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nearl!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Their sniper... is ridiculous!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: If Nearl gets hit again, she won't be able to defend herself anymore!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nearl, you need to retreat!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I can't... He's too powerful. I can't afford to let him hit our squads.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I have to intercept his attacks!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: She managed to block Faust's ballista... with only a shield--?!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Unbelievable... Impossible!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Do it again!! Blow her to pieces!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: What... it's coming from my right? !

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Oh no! Hurry, dodge--

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: As if I'd let you!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ace!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Snipers, take aim!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Target the raised platform to the south. Fire!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What?! How dare you... How dare you!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did we get him?

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: I doubt it. The most we can hope for... is to put some pressure on him.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Unfortunately, we don't have the time to dissect our enemies' tactics.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: He's very mobile and has high firepower. The longer this drags on, the less likely we'll be able to block his shots!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We can't give him time to set up...! Amiya, make your move while Team E3's Snipers keep him occupied!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Team E1 Snipers, come with me and suppress Reunion's forces!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Team E2, use all the firepower you have to break through their defensive line!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You filthy vermin...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Why won't you just obediently roll over and die?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Why can't I just put an end to you all right here?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...I want to kill... every... single... one... of you...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Nearl, now's your chance! Hurry!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: All members of Team E4, we're going to break through their formation!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We're going to clear everything out of our way in one fell swoop!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Let's run wild!!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Fire! Fire! Don't let her get any closer...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What?! She was twenty meters away just a moment ago...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Guhh... Aaarrghh!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: If you wish to stand against a Kazimierz knight, come back after you've trained a few more decades.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Dobermann! Follow me!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Understood!
